description: Unit test class for the ImmutableJsonKey class, testing immutability, equality semantics, input validation, and string/JSON pointer representations.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonKeyTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the ImmutableJsonKey class, verifying immutability, equality, validation, and string representations.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonKey instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for ImmutableJsonKey.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullKeyValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonKey with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptyKeyValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonKey with empty string throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method returns the key string.

methods.name: getKeyWithSlashesAsPointer
methods.description: Tests conversion of the key with slashes into a JsonPointer and checks its properties.
